papers.title: Sailor's letter
lines: The coconut crab climbs palms and steals the fruit. It is the size of a spaniel and twice as rude.
They told us to leave our sandwiches indoors. They did not say why. Now I know.

papers.title: Marker stone note
lines: Someone planted these palms. Someone lived here first. Both of these are true and neither is a joke.
Walk gently, speak quietly, and leave the island kinder than you found it.

papers.title: Lagoon survey note
lines: The lagoon is the colour of a swimming pool in a postcard, and the reef is the colour of a very good argument.
Fish counted: too many to count. Divers counted: three. We are in the way.

trail.clue: A surveyor's tin lies near the open ground. 'For the next survey, in a better mood.'

papers.title: Galley note
lines: Tonight: curry. Tomorrow: curry. Wednesday: it is a surprise, but it is also curry.
The cook insists that his curry is different each night. We are not convinced. We are not complaining.
